title: CERBON'S Better Beacons Fix
description: This project fixes an issue with Quark and CERBON'S Better Beacons, when the corrundum cluster color can't be loaded. This is making REALLY big lag because the check is run every tick.
body:
**DESCRIPTION:**

This mod fixes lag and an issue with [Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) and [CERBON's Better Beacons](https://modrinth.com/mod/cerbons-better-beacons), because in 1.21.1 Quark has changed color system for the currundum cluster. And because Better Beacons are trying to load the color every tick your game can experience really big lag spikes, I will try to send a PR to fix this, but for now this is the only fix.

**Installation:**

You need Quark and CERBON's Better Beacons for this to work
1. Download this Mod
2. Put it in your mods folder (normally %appdata%/.minecraft/mods)
3. Start your game
4. If there is an compatibility error this mod is not needed
4. If there is a crash please report it to my [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/Panzimy/BetterBeaconFix/issues)
